lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of prominent, high-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in approximately five horizontal rows between the branchial region and the caudal peduncle, with the highest-intensity centroids located along the mid-lateral line.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the horizontal rows of blobs, creating a distinct rectilinear grid where the circular blobs function as nodes at the intersections.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three primary longitudinal ridges are visible on the upper flank, defined by a sharp light-to-shadow gradient running parallel to the body axis from the posterior head region toward the tail.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The silhouette of the first dorsal fin contains a sparse distribution of small, high-luminance blobs, with a higher spatial frequency observed near the posterior trailing edge.

other_distinctive_markers: Multiple elongated, low-luminance silhouettes (remoras) are visible in close proximity to the ventral-lateral surface and the pectoral fin base.
